Subject: Inspect delivery after sending
Preview text: Capture an email.delivered event as a JSON POST request.

Hi there,

Sending a transactional email starts the workflow. Inspecting what happened afterward requires a separate delivery signal your application can capture.

Resend is a developer email platform that sends selected email events to a registered endpoint as real-time JSON POST requests. Subscribe to `email.delivered` to create a concrete event you can inspect during debugging.

The first step is to register a publicly accessible endpoint and select `email.delivered`. When that event occurs, Resend sends its details to your route in a JSON payload.

Follow the webhook guide to register the endpoint and evaluate whether the event format fits your application’s observability needs. The delivery event confirms delivery activity; it does not guarantee inbox placement.

Follow the webhook guide →

- the Resend team

Custom domain limits are 3 on Free, 10 on Pro, 1,000 on Scale, and Flexible on Enterprise
The Free plan includes 3,000 emails per month
The Free plan allows up to 100 emails a day
The Pro plan includes 50,000 emails per month
The Pro plan has no daily email limit
The Scale plan includes 1,000 domains

Test mode lets you simulate events and experiment with the API without risking sending real emails to real people

Resend monitors your DNS configuration for errors or regressions and notifies you of changes that could hinder deliverability
